name: OpenRPG
agentBrief: ATTRIBUTION: this is GDQuest's open-source OpenRPG demo (github.com/gdquest-demos/godot-open-rpg; MIT code, CC-BY 4.0 GDQuest art plus the CC0 packs listed in CREDITS.md) adapted for Summer Engine (Godot 4.6, GL Compatibility) — keep GDQuest credited in LICENSE/README/CREDITS.md and tell users to credit GDQuest in shipped games. A classical 2D top-down RPG demo, work-in-progress upstream. ENTRY SCENE: res://src/main.tscn (town map with NPCs, an opening cutscene and encounters; also overworld/maps/forest and overworld/maps/house). FIELD (src/field/): grid-based Gamepiece movement (src/field/gamepieces/gamepiece.gd, Path2D-based, no physics collision) over a Gameboard autoload that owns the pathfinder; GamepieceRegistry autoload tracks where everything is; controllers under src/field/gamepieces/controllers/ drive player and AI pieces; cutscenes/interactions under src/field/cutscenes/ (doors, pickups, conversations, combat encounters); inventory UI under src/field/ui/. COMBAT (src/combat/ + combat/): sequential turn-based combat (see CHANGELOG v0.3.4) — each round every Battler picks an action via menus, then actions execute; battlers (bear, bugcat, squirrel, wolf under combat/battlers/), actions under src/combat/actions/, combat UI under src/combat/ui/, arenas under combat/arenas/. DIALOGUE: the bundled Dialogic addon (addons/dialogic, vendored 2.0-Alpha-16, autoload Dialogic) runs .dtl timelines stored next to the maps (overworld/maps/town/*.dtl, opening_cutscene.dtl). The vendored addon carries a three-line local patch so it parses under the Summer engine's Godot 4.7-based GDScript analyzer (explicit `return` on all paths in Modules/Text/node_name_label.gd `_set`, Modules/Variable/subsystem_variables.gd `_get` and `VariableFolder._get`; identical to upstream Dialogic PR #2769). Do not re-vendor alpha-16 over it. Upgrading to Dialogic 2.0-alpha-20 is the real fix but is a breaking change (state/save system, custom subsystems, renamed animations, unified audio event) that needs an editor session to resave timelines and re-check dialogue_layout.tscn. AUTOLOADS (9, wired in project.godot): Camera, CombatEvents, FieldEvents, Gameboard, GamepieceRegistry, Music, Player, Transition, Dialogic — extend these rather than adding parallel singletons. INPUT ACTIONS (already bound): ui_left/right/up/down, select, interact, back, dialogic_default_action. ART: Kenney Tiny Town tileset plus GDQuest character art; many .png/.ttf/.ogg assets ship with their .import files committed. NOTE: no tests/ or verification scripts ship; upstream README still describes GDQuest's contribution workflow. CUSTOMIZE BY: adding maps under overworld/maps/ with new .dtl timelines, adding battlers and actions on the existing Battler/BattlerAction classes, extending inventory items — do not rewrite the Gameboard/Gamepiece/Dialogic spine.

userFacing.tagline: GDQuest's OpenRPG: a top-down 2D RPG with grid movement, dialogue, cutscenes and turn-based combat.
highlights: Grid-based overworld movement with a pathfinding gameboard and NPC controllers
Sequential turn-based combat with party battlers, actions and a combat UI
Dialogue and cutscenes authored as Dialogic timelines next to each map
Town, forest and house maps with doors, pickups, encounters and an inventory
Kenney Tiny Town art and CC0 music, all credited in CREDITS.md
MIT code and CC-BY 4.0 art by GDQuest, adapted for Summer Engine
